stories.title: Headway Flintshire relaunches brain injury support service in Mostyn
stories.summary: A support group for people affected by brain injury in Flintshire has relaunched. Headway Flintshire helps people living with an acquired brain injury, an injury to the brain that happens after birth, along with their families and carers. stories.title: Petition calls on UK Government to reject Connah’s Quay power station plans

stories.title: North Wales Police officer awarded King’s Police Medal for football policing work
stories.summary: A North Wales Police officer who became Wales’ first female football policing officer has been awarded the King’s Police Medal. stories.title: Calls to end term-time only pay for school support staff backed in Senedd
